outcome: caesarean section for failure to progress
cohort: The study included 11,687 singleton live births with cephalic presentation, attempted vaginal birth, and at least 37 completed weeks gestation.
finding: A strong positive relationship was found between neonatal head circumference quartile and the rates of caesarean section for failure to progress and intrapartum caesarean section for any indication.
mod_finding: Higher neonatal head circumference quartiles were strongly associated with increased odds of caesarean section for failure to progress and intrapartum caesarean section overall.
